summary:
Iteration 8 — tested all 5 new features from spec plus regression:
(1) GET /api/hr/notifications: manager gets pending_approval periods as kind=submitted (by/at), staff gets revision periods as kind=rejected (reason). End-to-end flow verified via API (staff creates TEST_Notif Aug 2026 → process → submit → manager sees it → reject with reason → staff sees it, manager no longer sees it). Dashboard UI shows notifications-panel with proper data-testid.
(2) UNIT_MINGGU schedule updated: S1 Mon-Fri 07:00-15:00 + Sat 08:00-14:00 (Sun off), S2 Mon-Fri 13:00-21:00 + Sun 08:00-14:00 (Sat off). Attendance shift detection verified for all three cases (Sun S2 late 10, Sat S1 on-time, Mon S2 late 5).
(3) /hr-manager/recap page has tab-shift (Rekap Shift) + tab-overtime (Rekap Lembur). nav-rekap present, old nav-rekap-shift removed, /hr-manager/shift-recap redirects to /recap?tab=shift. GET /api/hr/overtime-recap returns rows per payslip with overtime_hours/overtime_rate/overtime_pay/slip_status + totals. ot-table, ot-total-hours, ot-total-pay, ot-export-button, ot-month-input all present.
(4) Absensi page: searchable combobox (attendance-employee-search → attendance-employee-search-input, options employee-option-{NIK}) works; typing 'siti' filters to EMP-002 and selecting loads logs.
(5) Karyawan: 'Rate Lembur (Rp / jam)' input emp-overtime_hourly_rate-input defaults to 0 for new employees; table column employee-ot-rate-{NIK} shows Budi Rp 50.000; verified in Workbench overtime calc (5h × 50000 = 250000 add to overtime_pay/gross).

Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter8_new_features.py (7 tests). Updated test_schedules.py (test_list_schedules_defaults + rename test_attendance_minggu_saturday_off → test_attendance_minggu_saturday_s1) for new UNIT_MINGGU shape. Full regression pytest -n0 → 110/110 pass in ~33s across 8 files.

Frontend verified at preview URL via Playwright: Staff logs in → notifications panel shows 'Tidak ada draft payroll yang ditolak', nav includes dashboard/payroll/karyawan/absensi/jadwal-shift/rekap/pajak/konfigurasi (no old nav-rekap-shift), Rekap page has both tabs, OT page populates with Rp 0 for March (no overtime slips yet), shift-recap URL redirects correctly, attendance combobox filters & selects Siti, Employees table shows Budi OT rate Rp 50.000 + add-form has 'Rate Lembur/Jam' label with default 0.

Cleanup done: all TEST_ periods, TEST_ employees, orphan users, non-March attendance logs, rotations purged. Only Maret 2026 seed + 3 real employees + 2 BPJS_empty remain... wait: TEST_BSI_empty was leftover from earlier iter; now 0 TEST remain.
critical_code_review_comments: Overtime recap `overtime_recap` builds per-payslip emp dict with `.find({}, {"_id":0, "id":1, "overtime_hourly_rate":1})` — relies on dict iteration pattern `{e['id']: e async for ...}`; works but subtle. Fine.

schedules.py UNIT_MINGGU seed uses `_days(..., 5)` for S1 Sat 08-14 and `_days(..., 6)` for S2 Sun 08-14. `_days` builds Mon-Fri + ONE extra half-day. Good: produces exactly the right shape with no Sat for S2 and no Sun for S1. However, `seed_schedules` migration $set only runs when `shifts.size == 1` (old REG shape). For fresh installs the $setOnInsert handles it. Confirmed defaults load correctly.

/hr-manager/employees vs /hr-manager/karyawan: spec text uses 'Karyawan' nav label; actual route is /hr-manager/employees. Not a bug — spec only requires nav-karyawan link; the data-testid is correct.

DELETE /api/hr/employees/{id} does NOT remove the associated users entry; leaves orphan with email occupied → re-creating same email returns 400. Minor cleanliness issue; mitigated in iter8 tests by direct Mongo cleanup. Suggest cascading user delete in routes_hr.delete_employee.
EmployeeSearch combobox dropdown shows ALL employees even for very large lists (no scroll virtualization). Fine for 5-100 employees; may need rework if headcount >500.
OvertimeRecap.jsx computes CSV by joining with configured delimiter but does not strip embedded delimiter chars from name/department. Low risk; names are safe here.

test_tax_and_bsi.py / test_1721a1_and_delete_period.py: still don't guarantee cleanup of all TEST_ periods they create (manually re-observed TEST_Desember 2026 + TEST_BSI_empty after fresh pytest run). Not blocking but pollutes DB — recommend adding pytest fixtures with teardown that direct-Mongo-deletes any TEST_ period they created (same pattern as test_workflow_v7).
seed_data_creation: Created & deleted: TEST_Notif Aug 2026 (notification flow), TEST_UM01 employee + attendance logs on 2026-04-04/05/06 (UNIT_MINGGU shift detection), TEST_OTR1 employee (ot_rate default). All cleaned up via API + direct Mongo. Maret 2026 seed untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests now 110 total across 8 files. UNIT_MINGGU is 2-shift (S1/S2); old legacy test expecting REG shift was updated. Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -n0 -v`. Note: creating a TEST employee requires `gender` + `marital_status` ('TK' or 'K') in payload — those are mandatory Pydantic fields. DELETE /hr/employees doesn't cascade to users collection; direct Mongo cleanup needed. UNIT_MINGGU Saturday is now S1-active (not off). Attendance combobox replaces old select — use attendance-employee-search (button) + attendance-employee-search-input (CommandInput) + employee-option-{NIK} (CommandItem).
rca of the issue: No defects detected. Pre-existing legacy test (test_attendance_minggu_saturday_off) failed on new UNIT_MINGGU shape — correctly updated to assert S1 on Saturday. Pre-existing dashboard test failed due to leftover TEST_Desember 2026 from earlier iter test files that don't clean up; after direct-Mongo purge, dashboard reports Maret 2026 latest + correct totals.
